gloss: hand warmer; body warmer; heat pack

definitions.gloss: hand warmer; body warmer; disposable heat pack
definitions.explanation: A small packet that generates heat, used to warm the body during cold weather. Modern disposable versions contain iron powder that heats up through oxidation when exposed to air. There are also reusable types filled with lighter fluid.

examples.japanese: カイロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: I put a hand warmer in my pocket.

examples.english: It was cold, so I stuck an adhesive heat pack on my back.

notes:
A quintessentially Japanese winter item. The word comes from {懐炉|かいろ} (⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧ = pocket/bosom + ⟦{炉|ろ}→炉：13588_ro⟧ = heater), meaning a heater kept close to the body. Usually written in katakana in modern usage.

TYPES:
- ⟦{使|つか}い{捨|す}て→使い捨て：07665_tsukaisute⟧カイロ: disposable heat pack (most common type)
- ⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧カイロ: adhesive heat pack (sticks to clothing)
- ⟦{充電式|じゅうでんしき}→充電式：30242_juudenshiki⟧カイロ: rechargeable hand warmer

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- カイロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{貼|は}る→貼る：10447_haru⟧: to apply an adhesive heat pack
- カイロ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to carry a hand warmer
- カイロ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{温|あたた}かい→温かい：13395_atatakai⟧: the heat pack is warm

CULTURAL NOTE:
Disposable カイロ are sold at every convenience store and drugstore in Japan from autumn through spring. They are commonly given as comfort items to people working outdoors and are a standard part of winter preparation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湯|ゆ}たんぽ→湯たんぽ：07040_yutanpo⟧: hot water bottle — used in bed for warmth
- ホッカイロ: brand name (Hokkairo) often used generically for disposable heat packs
